pages.title: Spiritual Power
pages.text: Spiritual power is the foundation of cultivation. Absorbing spirit stones or using pills restores or builds your reserve, while techniques and breakthroughs consume it.

pages.title: Realms
pages.text: A realm represents your current stage of cultivation. After gathering enough spiritual power and experience, you can attempt a breakthrough. The Jiangchen Pill and other matching breakthrough aids can help, but basic requirements still apply.
